description: Consommation eau potable par quartier à Digne-les-Bains 2015 et 2016 is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Ville de Digne-les-Bains. Report on the sectorisation of the drinking water network of Digne-les-Bains by neighbourhood and per month for 2015 and 2016. Compressed files can extract data in XLS and ODS format: \- DIGNIFIED-CONSO-EAU-DIARTIER-2015 \- DIGNIFIED-CONSO-EAU-DIARTIER-2016. Coverage: Ville de Digne-les-Bains. The portal shows the English title as "Drinking water consumption by neighbourhood in Digne-les-Bains 2015 and 2016" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Ville de Digne-les-Bains. Its keywords include distribution, eau, canalisation, reseau, consommation. The listing shows 2 download or service links in ZIP. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/licence-ouverte-open-licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
